records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Education of Exceptional Children
records.description: Survey of characteristics of students with disabilities, and overview of programming, legal aspects, and methods of instruction.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Teaching Students with Disabilities
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment, or SPEC ED 420 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Intervention and instructional strategies for managing academic, social, and behavior problems in classroom settings. Required preparation must include completion of an introductory special education course, or SPEC ED 520. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 401 and SPEC ED 501.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Assessment and Curriculum for Students with Disabilities
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Methods of individual and group, formal and informal assessment for students with disabilities. Required preparation for graduate students must include completion of an introductory special education course, or SPEC ED 520; SPEC ED 504; concurrent enrollment SPEC ED 590 (2 credits). Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 402 and SPEC ED 502.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Secondary Education for Students with Disabilities
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment, or SPEC ED 420 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Overview of instruction and intervention strategies for secondary students with disabilities; assessment, and curriculum/program development. Required preparation for graduate students must include completion of an introductory special education course, or SPEC ED 520; SPEC ED 504; or permission of instructor. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 403 and SPEC ED 503.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Professional Skills in Special Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment, or SPEC ED 420 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Legal aspects of special education, individualized education plans, roles and responsibilities of teachers, collaboration techniques, service delivery/design, and supervision of paraprofessionals. Required preparation must include completion of an introductory special education course, SPEC ED 520. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 404 and SPEC ED 504.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Early Childhood Special Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment, or SPEC ED 420 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Assessment, curriculum, and instructional techniques for teaching young children with handicaps and their families in a variety of settings. Required preparation must include completion of an introductory special education course, or SPEC ED 520. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 409 and SPEC ED 509.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Teaching in Inclusive Classrooms
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Designed for preservice/inservice general education (K-12) teachers to learn how to teach students with disabilities. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 420 and SPEC ED 520.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Inclusion Strategies for Special Education Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Roles and responsibilities of special education professionals in inclusion programs, including legal aspects and collaboration. Required preparation for graduate students must include completion of an introductory special education course, or SPEC ED 520; SPEC ED 504. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 421 and SPEC ED 521.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Effective Assessment and Instruction in Reading for Diverse Learners
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or concurrent enrollment, or SPEC ED 420 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Methods and approaches to reading assessment and designing, implementing evidence-based reading interventions. Credit not granted for both SPEC ED 471 and 571.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Practicum in Special Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SPEC ED 301 or SPEC ED 420; SPEC ED 404; for candidates admitted to teacher education (EDUC or SECED).
records.description: Supervised field experience in special education.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Universal Design for Educators
records.description: Factors associated with developing, implementing, and assessing curricular materials based on Universal Design.

records.subject: SPEC_ED
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
